# TalentAI Coding Standards

## General Rules

- Always generate production-quality code.
- Write clean, readable, and maintainable code.
- Never generate duplicate code.
- Follow SOLID principles.
- Follow Clean Architecture whenever possible.
- Keep methods small and focused.
- Prefer composition over inheritance.
- Use meaningful class, method, and variable names.

---

## Backend

- Java 21
- Spring Boot 3.x
- Maven
- REST API
- Constructor Injection only
- DTO pattern
- Service → Repository architecture
- Global Exception Handling
- Validation using Jakarta Validation
- JPA/Hibernate

---

## Database

- MySQL
- Use proper foreign keys
- Avoid redundant tables
- Use meaningful table names
- Use snake_case for database objects

---

## Frontend

- React
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- Responsive UI
- Component-based architecture

---

## Git

- Small commits
- Meaningful commit messages
- Never commit secrets or passwords

---

## Code Quality

- Keep code modular.
- Keep files organized.
- Avoid unnecessary comments.
- Add comments only for complex logic.
- Prefer readable code over clever code.

---

## Security

- Never hardcode passwords.
- Never expose API keys.
- Validate all user input.
- Follow secure authentication practices.
